Based on your previous enjoyment of Christmas markets in Germany and your preference for traditional customs, strong community spirit, and snowy landscapes, I recommend considering Austria or Switzerland. Austria, particularly Vienna or Salzburg, offers world-renowned Christmas markets with a deep-rooted tradition of festive customs and a cozy, communal atmosphere. Similarly, Switzerland provides stunning snowy alpine scenery and charming towns like Zurich or Lucerne that host intimate, traditional markets. Both countries excel in preserving their cultural heritage while offering the winter wonderland experience you are seeking.
